raw_segments.text: Lardius, O noble fellow who sensibly outdares his senseless sword, and when it bows, stanst
he up. Thou art left, Mardius. A carbuncle and tire as big as thou art, were not so rich
a jewel. Thou wast a soldier even to Cotto's wish, not fierce and terrible only in strokes,
but with thy grim looks and the thunder-like percussion of thy sounds thou madst he thine
enemies shake, as if the world were feverous and did tremble.
